findings.issue: וַתִּקְרֶאנָה is qal wayyiqtol 3fp of H7122 (encounter/befall) with the speaker as object: a feminine-plural subject meets him. “me han hallado” continues the common-plural agents of acercaron, has them find him, and uses present perfect.

notes: He aquí, hoy, acercaron, su pecado, su holocausto, delante de Jehová, comí pecado hoy, and the question on ייטב match the tokens.
